operationSampling: Every stride-th operation per capture and calling thread; results are samples, not exhaustive contributions. Column field prefetch is a separate series.
timing: Monotonic elapsed CPU-side wall duration, not thread CPU consumption or GPU completion. Nested timings overlap. Queue timings include requests that reach execution.
bounds: Stop on time, sample or new-series limit; no ring eviction or automatic disk logging. A stopped capture is retained until clear, replacement or owner release.
threadMetadata: Raw samples retain thread ID and bounded thread name; series aggregate across threads but retain project, context and source UUID.
